seed: The 3D grips are one press away on a picked layer, at Next defaults with no flag changed (reworked 2026-11-01: the arcs on the knob became the 3D mode on the chip beside it). A title is typed over a recording and picked with the Select tool: the chip by its turn knob offers 3D. Switched to 3D, its right edge pill dragged sideways swings it 40 degrees and the title is drawn turned. Then a small rectangle is drawn and picked: its chip offers 3D too, and its top right corner, dragged with Shift to stretch, still resizes it to 90 wide.

steps.note: the title just picked, the pointer off in a corner: white corner squares and edge pills, the turn knob with its arrow, and the Size and 3D chip beside it, with no hover at all
the chip on 3D and the right edge pill dragged sideways: the title swung 40 degrees, its far edge shorter, with the 3D grips still on it

a small rectangle, 60 by 24, just picked (60 so its edges still clear the 34 point floor for pills at the 67% the canvas opens at under a taller timeline): the same chip by its knob, corners clear of each other
the small rectangle's top right corner dragged out with Shift: it stretched to 100 wide and stayed flat
